annotations.title: Tax-residency day counter (Spain, UAE, Portugal, US)

description: Counts days per country from a list of trips and applies each day test: Spain more than 183 days in the calendar year, UAE 183 days in any 12 months (or 90 with residence and home/job), Portugal more than 183 days in any 12 months, US substantial presence test. Trips as 'ES_20260110_20260620,AE_20260621_20261231' or a JSON array of {country, from, to}. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/tax-residency-day-counter/

trips.description: Comma-separated COUNTRY_YYYYMMDD_YYYYMMDD (countries ES, AE, PT, US); in MCP or POST also an array of {country, from: 'YYYY-MM-DD', to: 'YYYY-MM-DD'}
